items.scene: A pianist standing beside a piano with a broken keyboard.
items.caption: My piano repair business has hit a sour note.

items.scene: A tailor holding a torn jacket beside a sewing machine.
items.caption: This alteration business is coming apart at the seams.

items.scene: A pianist looking at an empty concert hall.
items.caption: An intimate audience tonight. Just me and the fire inspector.

items.scene: A cyclist beside a bicycle whose front wheel is folded after a crash.
items.caption: A small adjustment to the steering.

items.scene: A server carrying one plate toward a table crowded with diners.
items.caption: Dinner is running a little behind schedule. Only the menu has arrived.

items.scene: A cyclist pumping a tire beside a road.
items.caption: I have pumped this tire enough to change the local weather.

items.scene: An office worker facing a printer displaying a paper error.
items.caption: The printer has appointed itself editor and rejected my entire manuscript.

items.scene: A person beside a vending machine holding a coin it returned.
items.caption: The vending machine reviewed my application and decided to pursue other customers.

items.scene: An office worker carrying a tall stack of documents.
items.caption: We have printed enough copies to give every tree a biography.

items.scene: A traveler opening a suitcase full of spilled shampoo.
items.caption: Good news: every shirt now comes with a complimentary spa treatment.

items.scene: A person holding a house key beside a locked front door.
items.caption: I locked myself out, so today’s workout includes an outdoor waiting session.

items.scene: A traveler dragging several huge suitcases toward a taxi.
items.caption: I packed lightly. The taxi only needs a second taxi.
